dark_naming.structural_reading: Cosmology named the unknown majority 'dark' because it was only gravitational. Biology, oceanography, and microbiology later borrowed the word for their own effect-only remainders. That borrowing is the confession: we lack a vocabulary for 'majority of the system we can only infer.' It does NOT mean dark matter, dark taxa, dark oxygen, and microbial dark matter are the same stuff.
dark_naming.forbidden_inference: Do not unify these into one substance. Unify the epistemology.
